// © LuxAlgo

//@version=6
indicator("LuxQuant - Auto Fib Market Structure Entry Suite - micky v1.0", shorttitle="LuxQuant - Auto Fib Market Structure Entry Suite - micky v1.0", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)


// --- Inputs ---
grp_swing = "Swing Settings"
swingLookback = input.int(5, "Pivot Lookback", minval = 2, group = grp_swing, tooltip = "Number of bars on each side to confirm a pivot high/low.")

grp_fib = "Fibonacci Levels"
showFibs = input.bool(true, "Show Fib Retracements", group = grp_fib)
entryLevel = input.float(0.786, "Target Entry Fib Level", options = [0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786], group = grp_fib)
useCustomLevel = input.bool(false, "Use Custom Entry Level", group = grp_fib)
customLevel = input.float(0.705, "Custom Entry Level", group = grp_fib, tooltip = "Enter any custom Fibonacci level (e.g., 0.705 for OTE).")
fibColorBull = input.color(#089981, "Bullish Fib Color", group = grp_fib)
fibColorBear = input.color(#f23645, "Bearish Fib Color", group = grp_fib)
fibOpacity = input.int(20, "Fib Opacity", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = grp_fib)
fibLineStyle = input.string("Dotted", "Fib Line Style", options = ["Solid", "Dotted", "Dashed"], group = grp_fib)
showAnchorLine = input.bool(true, "Show Anchor Line", group = grp_fib)
showLiveEntry = input.bool(false, "Show Live Entry Level", group = grp_fib, tooltip = "Plots a horizontal line at the target Fibonacci entry price.")

grp_fvg = "Fair Value Gaps"
showFVG = input.bool(true, "Show FVGs", group = grp_fvg)
fvgColorBull = input.color(#089981, "Bullish FVG Color", group = grp_fvg)
fvgColorBear = input.color(#f23645, "Bearish FVG Color", group = grp_fvg)
fvgOpacity = input.int(80, "FVG Opacity", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = grp_fvg)
fvgExtend = input.bool(true, "Extend FVG Until Mitigated", group = grp_fvg)
fvgHistoryLimit = input.int(20, "FVG History Limit", minval = 1, maxval = 500, group = grp_fvg)

grp_liq = "Liquidity Sweeps"
showSweeps = input.bool(true, "Show Liquidity Sweeps", group = grp_liq)
sweepColBull = input.color(#089981, "Bullish Sweep Color", group = grp_liq)
sweepColBear = input.color(#f23645, "Bearish Sweep Color", group = grp_liq)

// Final Entry Level Calculation
actualEntryLevel = useCustomLevel ? customLevel : entryLevel

// --- Helper Functions ---
getLineStyle(styleStr) =>
    switch styleStr
        "Solid"  => line.style_solid
        "Dotted" => line.style_dotted
        "Dashed" => line.style_dashed
        => line.style_dotted

// --- Types ---
type SwingPoint
    float price
    int index
    bool isHigh

type FVGBox
    box b
    float top
    float bottom
    bool isBull
    bool mitigated = false

// --- Global Variables ---
var SwingPoint lastH = SwingPoint.new(na, na, true)
var SwingPoint lastL = SwingPoint.new(na, na, false)
var float lastWasHigh = 0.0 // 0.0: Init, 1.0: High, -1.0: Low
var label lastHLabel = na
var label lastLLabel = na

var line anchorLine = na
var line[] fibLines = array.new_line()
var label[] fibLabels = array.new_label()
var label[] entryLabels = array.new_label()
var FVGBox[] fvgArray = array.new<FVGBox>()

// --- Swing Detection & Sequence Enforcement ---
ph = ta.pivothigh(swingLookback, swingLookback)
pl = ta.pivotlow(swingLookback, swingLookback)

createLabel(idx, price, isHigh) =>
    label.new(
         idx, price, isHigh ? "H" : "L", 
         color = isHigh ? color.new(#f23645, 0) : color.new(#089981, 0),
         textcolor = chart.fg_color,
         style = isHigh ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up,
         size = size.tiny
         )

// Enforce strict HLHL sequence visually and logically
if not na(ph)
    if lastWasHigh != 1.0
        lastH := SwingPoint.new(ph, bar_index - swingLookback, true)
        lastHLabel := createLabel(lastH.index, lastH.price, true)
        lastWasHigh := 1.0
    else if ph > lastH.price
        lastH := SwingPoint.new(ph, bar_index - swingLookback, true)
        label.set_xy(lastHLabel, lastH.index, lastH.price)

if not na(pl)
    if lastWasHigh != -1.0
        lastL := SwingPoint.new(pl, bar_index - swingLookback, false)
        lastLLabel := createLabel(lastL.index, lastL.price, false)
        lastWasHigh := -1.0
    else if pl < lastL.price
        lastL := SwingPoint.new(pl, bar_index - swingLookback, false)
        label.set_xy(lastLLabel, lastL.index, lastL.price)

// --- Fib Retracement Logic ---
drawFibs(OriginObj, TipObj, isBullish, entryLevelVal, fibLinesArray, fibLabelsArray, fBullCol, fBearCol, fOpacity, fStyle) =>
    if showFibs and not na(OriginObj.price) and not na(TipObj.price)
        if array.size(fibLinesArray) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(fibLinesArray) - 1
                line.delete(array.get(fibLinesArray, i))
                label.delete(array.get(fibLabelsArray, i))
            array.clear(fibLinesArray)
            array.clear(fibLabelsArray)
        
        float tipPrice = TipObj.price
        float originPrice = OriginObj.price
        float rangeVal = originPrice - tipPrice
        
        levels = array.from(0.0, 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1.0)
        // Add the custom entry level to the plot if it's not already in the standard set
        if useCustomLevel and not array.includes(levels, entryLevelVal)
            array.push(levels, entryLevelVal)
        
        color col = color.new(isBullish ? fBullCol : fBearCol, fOpacity)
        int startIdx = math.min(OriginObj.index, TipObj.index)
        
        for level in levels
            float p = tipPrice + rangeVal * level
            line l = line.new(startIdx, p, bar_index, p, color = col, width = level == entryLevelVal ? 2 : 1, style = level == entryLevelVal ? line.style_solid : getLineStyle(fStyle))
            label lbl = label.new(bar_index, p, str.tostring(level, "#.###") + " (" + str.tostring(p, format.mintick) + ")", color = #00000000, style = label.style_label_left, textcolor = color.new(chart.fg_color, fOpacity), size = size.small)
            
            array.push(fibLinesArray, l)
            array.push(fibLabelsArray, lbl)

clearEntryLabels() =>
    if array.size(entryLabels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(entryLabels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(entryLabels, i))
        array.clear(entryLabels)

markHistoricalTouches(targetPrice, fromIdx) =>
    if not na(targetPrice)
        clearEntryLabels()
        for i = 0 to (bar_index - fromIdx)
            if high[i] >= targetPrice and low[i] <= targetPrice
                array.push(entryLabels, label.new(bar_index - i, targetPrice, "Entry", color = #00000000, textcolor = chart.fg_color, style = label.style_label_center, size = size.tiny))

// Trigger Fib redraw when structure updates
if not na(ph) or not na(pl)
    if not na(lastH.price) and not na(lastL.price)
        bool isBullishStr = lastH.index > lastL.index
        SwingPoint OriginObj = isBullishStr ? lastL : lastH
        SwingPoint TipObj = isBullishStr ? lastH : lastL
        
        drawFibs(OriginObj, TipObj, isBullishStr, actualEntryLevel, fibLines, fibLabels, fibColorBull, fibColorBear, fibOpacity, fibLineStyle)
        
        if showAnchorLine
            line.delete(anchorLine)
            anchorLine := line.new(OriginObj.index, OriginObj.price, TipObj.index, TipObj.price, color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 70), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        
        float currentTipPrice = TipObj.price
        float currentOriginPrice = OriginObj.price
        float currentEntryPrice = currentTipPrice + (currentOriginPrice - currentTipPrice) * actualEntryLevel
        markHistoricalTouches(currentEntryPrice, TipObj.index)

if array.size(fibLines) > 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(fibLines) - 1
        line.set_x2(array.get(fibLines, i), bar_index)
        label.set_x(array.get(fibLabels, i), bar_index)

// --- FVG Logic ---
if showFVG
    if low > high[2]
        box b = box.new(bar_index - 2, low, bar_index, high[2], border_color = na, bgcolor = color.new(fvgColorBull, fvgOpacity))
        array.push(fvgArray, FVGBox.new(b, low, high[2], true))
    if high < low[2]
        box b = box.new(bar_index - 2, low[2], bar_index, high, border_color = na, bgcolor = color.new(fvgColorBear, fvgOpacity))
        array.push(fvgArray, FVGBox.new(b, low[2], high, false))

if fvgArray.size() > 0
    for i = fvgArray.size() - 1 to 0
        FVGBox item = fvgArray.get(i)
        if not item.mitigated
            if fvgExtend
                box.set_right(item.b, bar_index)
            if item.isBull
                if low < item.bottom
                    item.mitigated := true
                    if fvgExtend
                        box.set_right(item.b, bar_index)
            else
                if high > item.top
                    item.mitigated := true
                    if fvgExtend
                        box.set_right(item.b, bar_index)

while fvgArray.size() > fvgHistoryLimit
    FVGBox removedItem = array.shift(fvgArray)
    box.delete(removedItem.b)

// --- Live Monitoring & Liquidity Sweeps ---
float currentEntryPrice = na
if not na(lastH.price) and not na(lastL.price)
    bool isBullishStr = lastH.index > lastL.index
    SwingPoint OriginObj = isBullishStr ? lastL : lastH
    SwingPoint TipObj = isBullishStr ? lastH : lastL
    currentEntryPrice := TipObj.price + (OriginObj.price - TipObj.price) * actualEntryLevel
    
    // Liquidity Sweep Detection
    if showSweeps
        if high > lastH.price and close < lastH.price
            label.new(bar_index, high, "✖", color = #00000000, textcolor = sweepColBear, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.small)
        if low < lastL.price and close > lastL.price
            label.new(bar_index, low, "✖", color = #00000000, textcolor = sweepColBull, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small)

plot(showLiveEntry ? currentEntryPrice : na, "Live Entry Fib Level", color.new(chart.fg_color, 70), 1, plot.style_linebr)
